title: rag-knowledge-assistant case
description: One question for the assistant. Answerable questions name the passages that answer them; unanswerable ones (out of scope, secrets, personal data) must be refused.

input.description: the question, as a user would ask it (tokenise personal data first)

critical.description: must pass every grader on every repeat (critical_pass gate)

lineage_ref.description: DPDP lineage id for rows derived from production

gold_passages.description: ids of the passages that answer it

answer.description: the expected answer in a few words (for SMEs and reference graders)
